title: Compute SHG efficiency spectrum
action: Using an open-source RCWA solver (e.g., S4), set up the MIM grating geometry with nominal parameters: period d=544 nm, gold ribbon width w=235 nm, ribbon thickness t=40 nm, GaAs layer thickness h=152 nm, and semi-infinite gold mirror. Use gold Drude model (λp=159 nm, γ=0.0075) and GaAs refractive index n=3.3. For each pump wavelength from 2.9 µm to 3.3 µm (step ≤0.01 µm), simulate the TM-polarized pump field and the TE-polarized signal field at λ/2. Compute the nonlinear polarization from the product of the in-plane and out-of-plane pump field components, then derive the SHG efficiency Π = P_SH G/P_inc² in W⁻¹. Write the resulting spectrum as a CSV file.
description: CSV file containing the computed SHG efficiency as a function of pump wavelength.
output_schema: Two columns: wavelength_um (float, µm) and efficiency_W-1 (float, W⁻¹). Data ordered by increasing pump wavelength.
